notes.subject: באיתן
notes.rationale: KJV rit 'in strength' (באיתן = strongpela ples); JPS/BSB rit olsem nem bilong ples 'Eitan'; mi go long rit bilong KJV.

notes.subject: אביר / אבן
notes.rationale: 'Strongpela Man' na 'ston' — tupela tok i sanap klostu, olsem Jakob i mekim nem long lotu (Stat 49:24 tasol).

notes.subject: longen
notes.rationale: משם i minai 'longen' (long Strongpela Man) o 'long ples ya' (long ples bilong Yerusalayim); KJV/JPS i holim namba-wan pas.

translation: Tasol bokis sut bilong em i stap strongpela, na ol han bilong em i kamap strong — wantaim han bilong Strongpela Man bilong Yakov; longen i kamap man bilong lukautim ol sipsip, ston bilong Yisrael.

tokens.gloss: i kamap man bilong lukautim ol sipsip
